name: ThirdShotHub Thermal Paddle Sleeve
description: The ThirdShotHub Thermal Paddle Sleeve is an insulated single-paddle cover for players who leave gear in a vehicle. A 4 mm closed-cell foam wall with a reflective liner slows the rate at which a paddle core reaches the temperature at which its honeycomb bond softens; in ThirdShotHub's own trunk testing it held a paddle under 100F for about ninety minutes at a 125F ambient. It is a delay, not a substitute for bringing the paddle inside.

specifications.fits: Standard and elongated paddles to 16.5 in
specifications.wall: 4 mm closed-cell foam with reflective liner
specifications.closure: Full-length YKK zipper with storm flap
specifications.measured_performance: Held paddle under 100F for ~90 minutes at 125F ambient

care_instructions: Spot clean only; machine washing crushes the closed-cell foam and permanently reduces the insulation. Air out after humid sessions — the reflective liner traps moisture against a damp paddle face. Treat the stated ninety-minute figure as a delay for an unavoidable errand, not a licence to store a paddle in a hot vehicle; sustained heat damage to a core is not covered by any paddle warranty.
